name: blockscore-backend-node-services
description: Dependency manifest for the standalone Node.js service modules in code/backend (services/contractService.js, services/authService.js, middleware/auth.js). The actual running BlockScore backend is the Flask app in app.py - see code/backend/requirements.txt - these modules are not currently wired into a server (there is no app.js or routes/ directory in this project). This file exists so the modules that do exist are installable and importable rather than failing on the first `require`.
